peer_results.rationale: The retrieved candidates for AMD describe the repayment of specific 2024 Xilinx Notes ($750 million) and the entry into a new joint venture term loan. Unlike AVGO, AMD does not disclose a large-scale refinancing of existing term loans via new senior note issuances in the same context, nor does it discuss the write-off of unamortized discount costs associated with major loan repayments. The topics are distinct enough (specific note maturity vs. broad term loan refinancing) to not be considered substantively comparable for this specific target disclosure regarding 2024 Term Loan repayments and associated write-offs.

comparisons.peer_summary: In 2024, the company issued $2.6 billion in senior notes and settled $1.9 billion in maturing senior notes via cash. The company also issued $11.0 billion in senior notes in 2023.
comparisons.comparison: Both AVGO and INTC disclose debt refinancing activities in fiscal year 2024 involving the issuance of new senior notes to repay existing debt. AVGO used proceeds from senior notes issued in July and October 2024 to repay Term Loans, whereas INTC issued $2.6 billion in senior notes in 2024 and used cash (potentially from operations or other sources, distinct from the note proceeds in the same sentence) to settle $1.9 billion of maturing senior notes. Both companies are actively managing their capital structures by replacing older debt instruments with new issuances or cash payments during the fiscal year.

sentences.text: During fiscal year 2024, we repaid $11,195 million of our Term A-2 Loan using the net proceeds from the senior notes issued in July 2024 and the sale of the EUC business, as well as cash on hand.
We also repaid $5,600 million of our Term A-3 Loan using the net proceeds from the senior notes issued in October 2024 and cash on hand.
In 2024, we issued a total of $2.6 billion aggregate principal amount of senior notes, and settled in cash $1.9 billion of our senior notes that matured in May 2024 and June 2024.

comparisons.peer_summary: In 2023, the company issued $6.70 billion of senior unsecured notes and term loans, receiving $6.69 billion in cash, and prepaid $600 million of the 2024 Term Loan A principal.
comparisons.comparison: Both AVGO and MU disclose debt repayment and refinancing activities involving term loans and senior notes. AVGO repaid Term A-2 and Term A-3 loans in fiscal year 2024 using proceeds from senior notes issued in the same year. MU's disclosure in Item 8 summarizes 2023 activities where it issued senior unsecured notes and term loans to prepay a 2024 Term Loan A. While the fiscal years for the specific transactions differ (AVGO's note issuance and loan repayment occurred in 2024, while MU's disclosed activity in this summary is from 2023), both disclosures illustrate the same corporate strategy of issuing debt instruments to fund the retirement of existing term loan obligations.
